exposure: Placental metals (Arsenic, Cobalt, Manganese, Molybdenum, Nickel, Lead, Antimony, Selenium, Tin, Vanadium, Cadmium, Chromium, Copper)
outcome: Estradiol (E2) levels in umbilical cord blood
Testosterone (TTE) levels in umbilical cord blood
cohort: The study included 533 pregnant women from the Hangzhou Birth Cohort Study II (HBCS-II).
finding: Neighborhood walkability was significantly linked to increased E2 levels, and this association, along with that for TTE, was significantly modified by specific placental metals.
